messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "10 mg/day for lower-weight children"
set: ["10 mg/day for lower-weight children", "10 mg/day for adolescents and higher-weight children", "10 mg/day", "10 mg/day for panic disorder", "10 mg/day to 60 mg/day for panic disorder", "in lower-weight children, starting dose and target dose may remain at 10 mg/day", "20 mg to 30 mg per day for lower-weight children", "600 mg/day for inpatients", "400 mg/day for outpatients", "children 10 years and older", "children younger than 10 years old", "children at least 10 years old", "increase to 20 mg/day after 2 weeks for adolescents and higher-weight children", "20 mg/day", "10 mg subcutaneously once a week for children 10 years and older with Type 2 Diabetes", "80 mg/day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
